item.title: 'The BIGGEST CLICKBAIT of All Time' Involving Megadeth’s DAVE MUSTAINE
item.description: Dave Mustaine Sentenced to Life? No, Dave Mustaine isn’t in prison. Yes, people actually believed he was. And of course, someone on YouTube made money off it.

item.title: David Ellefson Breaks Down Megadeth’s Risk and Its Divisive Legacy
item.description: In 1999, Megadeth rolled the dice with Risk, a record that veered sharply away from the band’s thrash metal identity. For David Ellefson, the album remains, in his own words, “probably the most controversial album in the catalog.
